headline: Dollar rates surge: Open market price hits 128.50 BDT
summary: Both the open market and banking channels have seen a rise in US dollar rates, increasing import costs and affecting other foreign currencies.
details: The price of the US dollar has suddenly increased in the open market, reaching 128.50 BDT per dollar. Banking channels have also seen a rise, with banks now selling cash dollars at 126.50 BDT.

According to bank data, City Bank bought cash dollars from returning travelers at 124.75 BDT and sold them at 126 BDT last Thursday. BRAC Bank bought at 125.50 BDT and sold at 126.50 BDT, while UCB bought at 125 BDT and sold at 126.25 BDT.

Agrani Bank offered a lower rate, buying cash dollars at 123 BDT and selling at 124 BDT. Meanwhile, the cost of dollars purchased by banks for imports has also risen, with interbank rates reaching 123.99 BDT last Thursday.

Bangladesh Bank and bank officials stated that travel between Bangladesh and the Middle East has significantly decreased following the Middle East crisis, leading to a shortage of dollars in the open market.

The price of the dollar has increased by up to 1 BDT in both the open market and banking channels over the last 10 days. This surge has also driven up the value of other foreign currencies and increased the overall cost of imports.

headline: Actor Shariful Raj gets legal notice over scheduling conflict
summary: Real Energy Production claims the actor failed to provide shooting dates for the film 'Thikana', leading to a legal ultimatum.
details: Real Energy Production has issued a legal notice to actor Shariful Raj, demanding he provide a shooting schedule within 48 hours or face legal action.
